intro.es: Una herramienta para que las familias hispanas conozcan, semana a semana, las actividades en las que participan sus hijos en el Scouting.
intro.en: A tool for families to follow, week by week, the activities their children take part in.

summary.es: La Aventura Bobcat es la primera Aventura obligatoria de tu camino y hará que tú y tu den comiencen muy bien. Una vez completada la Aventura Bobcat, puedes trabajar en las demás Aventuras en el orden que desees. Bobcat se centra en el carácter y en presentar los valores de Scouting America.
summary.en: The Bobcat Adventure is the first required Adventure on your trail and will get you and your den off to a great start. Once you have completed the Bobcat Adventure, you can work on the other Adventures in any order. Bobcat is focused on character and introducing the values of Scouting America.

summary.es: Un oso está en su hogar al aire libre, y también lo está un Bear Cub Scout. En esta Aventura, aprenderás a planear una caminata de una milla con tu den. Cuando estamos afuera, también tenemos la responsabilidad de asegurarnos de que otros puedan disfrutar del aire libre.
summary.en: A bear is at home in the outdoors, and so is a Bear Cub Scout. In this Adventure, you’ll learn how to plan a one-mile walk with your den. Your walk may be around where you live, it may be on a historical trail that has been in use for hundreds of years, or it may be on a nature trail. When we are outside, we also have responsibilities to make sure that others can enjoy the outdoors too. Knowing and following the Leave No Trace Principles for Kids helps us do just that.

summary.es: En el Scout Oath (Juramento Scout), los Cub Scouts prometen mantenerse físicamente fuertes y mentalmente despiertos. La condición física personal consiste en mantener el cuerpo fuerte comiendo bien y haciendo ejercicio, pero también significa descansar lo suficiente y ejercitar la mente.
summary.en: In the Scout Oath, Cub Scouts promise to keep themselves physically strong and mentally awake. Personal fitness is about keeping your body strong by eating right and exercising, but it also means getting enough rest and exercising your mind by reading, solving problems, or even listening to music.

summary.es: Esta Aventura trata sobre los Estados Unidos y los poderosos símbolos que representan lo mejor de nuestro país, y sobre cómo las comunidades se unen para resolver los problemas que enfrentan. La ciudadanía en Estados Unidos se trata de participar.
summary.en: This Adventure is about America and the powerful symbols that represent the best of our country and how communities come together to help solve problems they are facing. Citizenship in America is about participation. One way to show citizenship is by making an impact locally through nonprofit organizations. Nonprofit organizations are places for people to give their time, talents, and resources to make a difference in their community. You, too, can make an impact by participating in a service project that makes your community a better place.

summary.es: En esta Aventura, las Protect Yourself Rules (Reglas para Protegerte) te darán orientación para mantenerte seguro. También identificarás maneras de usar los aparatos electrónicos de forma responsable y maneras de proteger tu cuerpo cuando juegas o trabajas.
summary.en: In this Adventure, the Protect Yourself Rules will give you guidance on keeping yourself safe. You will also identify ways to use electronics responsibly and ways to protect your body when you’re playing or working. When bears feel they are in danger, they may stand on their back legs, standing tall to let the danger know that they are brave and know how to keep themselves safe.

summary.es: Esta Aventura suele realizarse en casa con la familia del Cub Scout. Si se hace como den, asegúrese de que todos los padres y tutores conozcan el contenido y las actividades. Se puede obtener completando los requisitos O completando un emblema religioso de la elección de la familia.
summary.en: This Adventure is commonly done at home with the Cub Scout’s family. If it is being done as a den, ensure that every parent and guardian is aware of the content and the activities that the den will do, and allow for parents to opt out of doing it as a den activity and choose to complete the requirement at home. This Adventure may be earned by completing the requirements below OR by completing a religious emblem of the Cub Scout’s family’s choosing.

Camping is a fun way to spend time with family and friends. Prepare for your campout by gathering what you will bring with you and setting up a tent. Your den leader and parents will help you get ready. Find the best spot to pitch your tent, and make it your home for the campout.

There are many ways to make things go — electricity, fuel, and batteries, to name a few. Did you know that you have the power to make a boat sail in the water or that a car can move using the force of gravity? Propulsion is what gives an object (such as a plane, car, or boat) the power to move. You will learn different ways to make and propel vehicles. Think about how the shapes of cars, boats, and planes affect the distance they can go. In this Adventure, you’ll explore how you can use the air in your lungs, the force of gravity, and the power of your imagination to make things go.

The summertime is a great time to get together with your den or pack. The requirement for this Adventure is simple. Participate in three Cub Scout activities during the summer months. This can be at council-organized camps like day camp or resident camp, or it can be a den or pack get-together for a summertime picnic. To earn this Adventure as a Bear, you participate in summer activities during the summer after you completed the second grade.

A pocketknife is a useful tool to have for Scouting activities. It can also be dangerous if you don’t use it the right way. In this Adventure, you will learn how to use a pocketknife safely. You will also get to learn the basics of carving. This Adventure is required in order for you to use any knife during a Cub Scout activity as a third-grade Bear. Next year, you will need to earn the Chef’s Knife Webelos Adventure to earn the privilege of using a knife during a Cub Scout activity as a fourth-grade Webelos.

body.es: Esta baraja contiene cartas que ayudan a los líderes de den (grupo pequeño de Cub Scouts) a ofrecer un programa para completar todos los requisitos del rango Bear.
body.en: This deck contains cards to help den leaders deliver a program to complete all requirements for earning the Bear rank. How to use this deck 1. Review the other resource cards (black border) in this deck, and review the contents. 2. Pick the Adventure you want to work on in your next den meeting. 3. Remove all cards associated with that Adventure. 4. Scan the Adventure card, and review the webpage for the Adventure you chose. Read and follow the Safety Moment for the Adventure. 5. Select one activity card for each requirement to do in your meeting. 6. Scan the QR code for each activity you selected, and follow the directions on the activity page. 7. When conducting your den meeting, have your cards on hand to use as a quick guide. Scan here for a video that shows you how to use this deck. ‣

body.es: DEN LEADER TRAINING. ¡LISTO EN DOS HORAS! Ingrese a my.scouting.org. La capacitación específica del puesto consta de 16 módulos de video.
body.en: DONE IN TWO HOURS! Log on to my.scouting.org. If you don’t already have an account, you can create one to access training. This is the same place Safeguarding Youth training is located. Den leader position-specific training consists of 16 video modules that are, on average, 71/2 minutes long. Complete the training to earn your first patch!
